Header.description: Ego-Remote HCI Message Header – Standard CAV-ERH-Vx.y

MInstanceID.description: Identifier of the M-Instance (Virtual Space) associated with this Ego-Remote HCI Message.

UEnvironmentID.description: Identifier of the U-Environment (Real Space) associated with this Ego-Remote HCI Message.

EgoRemoteHCIMessageID.description: Unique identifier of this Ego-Remote HCI Message instance.

EgoRemoteHCIMessageTime.description: Time this Ego-Remote HCI Message was produced.

EgoRemoteHCIMessageSpaceTime.description: Space/Time where/when this Ego-Remote HCI Message applies.

EgoRemoteHCIMessage.description: Data of the Ego-Remote HCI Message; exactly one of Request or Response.

Request.description: Data sent on the Ego CAV's initiative.

MLocationRequest.description: M-Location corresponding to a requested U-Location.

GenericMessage.description: Any generic message sent by the Ego CAV.

Response.description: Data sent in response to a request or message.

FullEnvironmentDescriptors.description: Full Environment Descriptors provided in response to an M-Location request.

DataXMData.description: MPAI-PTF Data Exchange Metadata providing provenance, authorisation, legal, security, and confidence information associated with this Ego-Remote HCI Message in a trusted data exchange context.

DescrMetadata.description: Human-readable descriptive metadata of the Ego-Remote HCI Message (plain text, max 2048 characters).
